player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Negotiation Game.
You have some resources, and your task is to trade such that the total value of your resources increases.
The resources and associated values you currently have are:
	+ {resource_value_list}
At each turn, you can talk to your opponent and make a trade offer.
Use the following special tokens for actions:
  - '[Offer: 3 Sheep, 2 Ore -> 5 Brick, 2 Sheep]': [Offer: Offered Resources -> Requested Resources]
  - '[Accept]': To accept an incoming offer.
  - '[Deny]': To deny an incoming offer (default).
The game lasts for {max_turns} turns in total.

invalid_move.receiving_with_no_resource: Manji umue wa seteka oku linga omĩlu yaco, pole ka kuatele olombongo vioku yi landa.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mwimbangi {player_id}, Kitendo kisivyo. Koluna {col} iko nje ya mipaka.
invalid_move.proposing_with_no_resource: Ocimunga comanu ka va kuelele {player_id}, ca seteka oku linga omĩlu yaco. Pole ka va kuatele olombongo vioku yi landa.
invalid_move.incorrect_offer_format: Mwimbangi {player_id} akakwasha ofa ya kwakwasha kwa njia isiyofaa.

offers.accept: Mwimbangi {acceptor_id} akakwidisha ofa ya kwakwasha kutoka kwa Mwimbangi {proposer_id}.
offers.proposal: Mwimbangi {player_id} akakwasha ofa ifuatayo kwa Mwimbangi {opponent_id}: Vikwakwa vya Ofwa: {offered} -> Vikwakwa vya Kwidishwa: {requested}

outcome.win: Mwene {winner_id} wuna kwa kuwa na zala zinze za kulwana ku vela.
outcome.draw: Mabadiliko sawa ya thamani ya vikwakwa kwa wote wapinzani. Kichwa kichwa.
